ethnic_groups.name: Luo

ethnic_groups.name: Kisii (Gusii)

ethnic_groups.name: Meru/Embu/Mbeere

ethnic_groups.name: Mijikenda

ethnic_groups.name: Maasai

ethnic_groups.name: Somali

ethnic_groups.name: Samburu
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Rift Valley; Nilotic; closely related to Maasai

ethnic_groups.name: Pokot/Rendille/Borana/Orma
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Kenya; pastoralists; cross-border ties with Ethiopia and Somalia

ethnic_groups.name: Swahili/Arab/Shirazi
ethnic_groups.notes: Coastal; Mombasa, Lamu, Malindi; Islamic heritage; trade and seafaring

ethnic_groups.name: Asian (South Asian)
ethnic_groups.notes: Gujarati, Punjabi communities; commercial and professional class; arrived during colonial era

natural_resources.notes: East Africa's largest economy; tourism backbone ($2.5B pre-COVID, Big Five safari, Masai Mara, Indian Ocean coast); tea world's #3 exporter; cut flowers #1 globally; geothermal energy leader (Olkaria, 7th globally); oil discovery in Turkana (2012, commercial viability uncertain)

military.notes: Kenya Defence Forces; Operation Linda Nchi (entered Somalia 2011, integrated into AMISOM/ATMIS); Al-Shabaab retaliatory attacks (Westgate mall 2013, Garissa University 2015—148 killed); professional military; UK/US military training; Mount Kenya British Army training area

infrastructure.notes: Most connected in East Africa; Konza Technopolis (Silicon Savannah); SGR railway; 5G launched 2022 (Safaricom).

debt_aid.notes: Chinese BRI loans (Standard Gauge Railway Mombasa-Nairobi $3.8B); debt servicing >50% of revenue; Eurobond borrowing; 2024 Finance Bill protests (youth-led 'Gen Z revolution', scrapped after deaths); Vision 2030

education.notes: English-language instruction (Swahili also official); free primary since 2003 (Kibaki); competency-based curriculum reform 2017; strong private university sector; Kenyan students excel at international competitions; running culture crossover to academic achievement narrative

diaspora_migration.diaspora_population: 3.0 million (USA ~200k, UK ~250k, Australia, Canada, UAE, South Africa, Uganda)
diaspora_migration.notes: Dadaab refugee camp (Somali refugees, among world's largest, population contested); Kakuma camp (South Sudanese, Congolese); Kenyan diaspora highly skilled; M-Pesa enables instant remittance transfer; Obama connection (Kenya's most famous diaspora link)

digital_economy.mobile_money_adoption: World leader (M-Pesa, 34M+ users, transactions 45% of GDP)
tech_hubs: Nairobi ('Silicon Savannah': iHub, Konza Technopolis, Nailab, MEST)
digital_economy.notes: Africa's undisputed tech capital; M-Pesa (2007) revolutionized global mobile money; Konza Technopolis smart city ($14.5B); iHub incubator ecosystem; BRCK, Ushahidi, Twiga Foods tech successes; Netflix/Google/Microsoft Africa HQ in Nairobi; Starlink early African adopter; fiber backbone strong

country_profile.notes_unique: Home to the Great Rift Valley and major fossil hominid discoveries (Turkana Boy, 'Millennium Man'); Maasai Mara hosts the world's largest annual wildlife migration.
country_profile.national_anthem: Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu (O God of All Creation)

geography.terrain: Low-lying coastal plain; Great Rift Valley with highlands on either side; arid northern plateau; Lake Victoria basin in west
geography.notes: Equatorial; Great Rift Valley bisects; Mount Kenya (5199m, 2nd in Africa); Maasai Mara–Serengeti ecosystem; Indian Ocean coastline.

economy_extended.notes: East Africa's largest economy; M-Pesa mobile money pioneer; Nairobi tech hub ('Silicon Savannah'); tea #1 exporter; horticulture powerhouse; SGR railway (China-funded); 2024 Finance Bill protests.

health.notes: NHIF transitioning to SHIF (Social Health Insurance Fund); Linda Mama maternity; doctors strike challenges; private healthcare growing.

food_agriculture.notes: World's #1 tea exporter; #1 cut flower exporter (Naivasha); avocado exports booming; Maasai pastoralism; Food insecurity in arid north.

energy.notes: Olkaria geothermal (largest in Africa, ~40% of mix); Lake Turkana Wind Power (310MW, Africa's largest wind farm); 93% of electricity from renewables; oil discovery (Turkana, not yet producing).

transport.notes: Mombasa port serves landlocked neighbors (Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan); Standard Gauge Railway (SGR, Nairobi-Mombasa, 2017); matatu minibus culture.

unesco_sites_list: Kenya Lake System in the Great Rift Valley
tourism.notes: Safari tourism iconic; Great Wildebeest Migration (Mara-Serengeti); beach tourism (Diani, Watamu, Lamu); Karen Blixen (Out of Africa); e-visa system.

human_rights_gender.notes: 2010 Constitution reformed rights landscape; two-thirds gender rule not fully implemented; extrajudicial killings concern; 2024 Gen Z protests (Finance Bill).

security_stability.notes: Al-Shabaab attacks (Westgate 2013, Garissa 2015, DusitD2 2019); AMISOM/ATMIS contributor; police brutality concerns; 2024 Finance Bill protests.

intangible_heritage_items: Traditions and practices associated with the Kayas (UNESCO)
notable_historical_figures: Wangari Maathai (Nobel Peace 2004, Green Belt Movement)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: Vibrant and competitive; Nation Media Group, Standard Group, Royal Media; KBC state; NTV, K24, Citizen TV
cultural_heritage.notes: Birthplace of M-Pesa; marathon running dominance (Kalenjin); Swahili lingua franca; safari tourism origin; Obama's ancestral homeland.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Mixed: English common law and customary law
legal_system.sharia_applicability: Kadhi courts for Muslim personal status (constitutional)
legal_system.customary_law_role: Recognized but subordinate to statute law
legal_system.notes: 2010 Constitution transformative (devolution, Bill of Rights); Supreme Court nullified 2017 election; 47 counties devolved system.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: East Africa's economic hub; tech and innovation leader.
